9.101.d: पुरोजिती वो अन्धसः सुताय मादयित्नवे | अप शवानं शनथिष्टन सखायो दीर्घजिह्व्यम ||
9.101.e: FOR first possession of your juice, for the exhilarating drink,  Drive ye away the dog, my friends, drive ye the long-tongued dog away.

9.101.d: यो धारया पावकया परिप्रस्यन्दते सुतः | इन्दुरश्वो न कर्त्व्यः ||
9.101.e: He who with purifying stream, effused, comes flowing hitherward,  Indu, is like an able steed.

9.101.d: तं दुरोषमभी नरः सोमं विश्वाच्या धिया | यज्ञं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ||
9.101.e: The men with all-pervading song send unassailable Soma forth,  By pressing-stones, to sacrifice.

9.101.d: सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इन्द्राय मन्दिनः | पवित्रवन्तोक्षरन देवान गछन्तु वो मदाः ||
9.101.e: The Somas, very rich in sweets, for which the sieve is destined, flow,  Effused, the source of Indra's joy: may your strong juices reach the Gods.

9.101.d: इन्दुरिन्द्राय पवत इति देवासो अब्रुवन | वाचस पतिर्मखस्यते विश्वस्येशान ओजसा ||
9.101.e: Indu flows on for Indra's sake: thus have the Deities declared.  The Lord of Speech exerts himself, Ruler of all, because of might.

9.101.d: सहस्रधारः पवते समुद्रो वाचमीङखयः | सोमः पती रयीणां सखेन्द्रस्य दिवे-दिवे ||
9.101.e: Inciter of the voice of song, with thousand streams the ocean flows,  Even Soma, Lord of opulence, the Friend of Indra, day by day.

9.101.d: अयं पूषा रयिर्भगः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति | पतिर्विश्वस्य भूमनो वयख्यद रोदसी उभे ||
9.101.e: As Pūṣan, Fortune, Bhaga, comes this Soma while they make him pure.  He, Lord of the multitude, hath looked upon the earth and heaven.

9.101.d: समु परिया अनूषत गावो मदाय घर्ष्वयः | सोमासः कर्ण्वते पथः पवमानास इन्दवः ||
9.101.e: The dear cows lowed in joyful mood together to the gladdening drink.  The drops as they were purified, the Soma juices, made then paths.

9.101.d: य ओजिष्ठस्तमा भर पवमन शरवाय्यम | यः पञ्चचर्षणीरभि रयिं येन वनामहै ||
9.101.e: O Pavamana, bring the juice, the mightiest, worthy to be famed,  Which the Five Tribes have over them, whereby we may win opulence.

9.101.d: सोमाः पवन्त इन्दवो.अस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमः | मित्राः सुवाना अरेपसः सवाध्यः सवर्विदः ||
9.101.e: For us the Soma juices flow, the drops best furtherers of our weal,  Effused as friends without a spot, benevolent, finders of the light.

9.101.d: सुष्वाणासो वयद्रिभिश्चिताना गोरधि तवचि | इषमस्मभ्यमभितः समस्वरन वसुविदः ||
9.101.e: Effused by means of pressing-stones, upon the ox-hide visible,  They, treasure-finders, have announced food unto us from every side.

9.101.d: एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः | सूर्यासो न दर्शतासो जिगत्नवो धरुवा घर्ते ||
9.101.e: Tlese Soma juices, skilled in song, purified, blent with milk and curd,  When moving and when firmly laid in oil, resemble lovely Suns.

9.101.d: पर सुन्वानस्यान्धसो मर्तो न वर्त तद वचः | अप शवानमराधसं हता मखं न भर्गवः ||
9.101.e: Let not the power of men restrain the voice of the outpouring juice:  As Bhṛgu's sons chased Makha, so drive ye the greedy hound away.

9.101.d: आ जामिरत्के अव्यत भुजे न पुत्र ओण्योः | सरज्जारो न योषणां वरो न योनिमासदम ||
9.101.e: The Friend hath wrapped him in his robe, as in his parents arms, a son.  He went, as lover to a dame, to take his station suitor-like.

9.101.d: स वीरो दक्षसाधनो वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी | हरिः पवित्रे अव्यत वेधा न योनिमासदम ||
9.101.e: That Hero who produces strength, he who hath propped both worlds apart,  Gold-hued, hath wrapped him in the sieve, to settle, priest-like, in his place.

9.101.d: अव्यो वारेभिः पवते सोमो गव्ये अधि तवचि | कनिक्रदद वर्षा हरिरिन्द्रस्याभ्येति निष्क्र्तम ||
9.101.e: Soma upon the ox's skin through the sheep's wool flows purified.  Bellowing out, the Tawny Steer goes on to Indra's special place.

9.102.d: कराणा शिशुर्महीनां हिन्वन्न्र्तस्य दीधितिम | विश्वापरि परिया भुवदध दविता ||
9.102.e: THE Child, when blended with the streams, speeding the plan of sacrifice,  Surpasses all things that are dear, yea, from of old.

9.102.d: उप तरितस्य पाष्योरभक्त यद गुहा पदम | यज्ञस्य सप्त धामभिरध परियम ||
9.102.e: The place, near the two pressing-stones of Trita, hath he occupied,  Secret and dear through seven lights of sacrifice.

9.102.d: तरीणि तरितस्य धारया पर्ष्ठेष्वेरया रयिम | मिमीते अस्य योजना वि सुक्रतुः ||
9.102.e: Urge to three courses, on the heights of Trita, riches in a stream.  He who is passing wise measures his courses out.

9.102.d: जज्ञानं सप्त मातरो वेधामशासत शरिये | अयं धरुवो रयीणां चिकेत यत ||
9.102.e: Even at his birth the Mothers Seven taught him, for glory, like a sage,  So that he, firm and sure, hath set his mind on wealth.

9.102.d: अस्य वरते सजोषसो विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः | सपार्हा भवन्ति रन्तयो जुषन्त यत ||
9.102.e: Under his sway, of one accord, are all the guileless Deities:  Warriors to be envied, they, when they are pleased.

9.102.d: यमी गर्भं रताव्र्धो दर्शे चारुमजीजनन | कविं मंहिष्ठमध्वरे पुरुस्प्र्हम ||
9.102.e: The Babe whom they who strengthen Law have generated fair to see,  Much longed for at the sacrifice, most liberal Sage,—

9.102.d: समीचीने अभि तमना यह्वी रतस्य मातरा | तन्वाना यज्ञमानुषग यदञ्जते ||
9.102.e: To him, united, of themselves, come the young Parents of the rite,  When they adorn him, duly weaving sacrifice.

9.102.d: करत्वा शुक्रेभिरक्षभिरणोरप वरजं दिवः | हिन्वन्न्र्तस्य दीधितिं पराध्वरे ||
9.102.e: With wisdom and with radiant eyes unbar to us the stall of heaven,  Speeding at solemn rite the plan of Holy Law.

9.103.d: पर पुनानाय वेधसे सोमाय वच उद्यतम | भर्तिं न भरा मतिभिर्जुजोषते ||
9.103.e: To Soma who is purified as ordering Priest the song is raised:  Bring meed, as ’twere, to one who makes thee glad with hymns.

9.103.d: परि वाराण्यव्यया गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षति | तरी षधस्था पुनानः कर्णुते हरिः ||
9.103.e: Blended with milk and curds he flows on through the long wool of the sheep.  The Gold-hued, purified, makes him three seats for rest.

9.103.d: परि कोशं मधुश्चुतमव्यये वारे अर्षति | अभि वाणीरषीणां सप्त नूषत ||
9.103.e: On through the long wool of the sheep to the meath-dropping vat he flows:  The Ṛṣis’ sevenfold quire hath sung aloud to him.

9.103.d: परि णेता मतीनां विश्वदेवो अदाभ्यः | सोमः पुनानश्चम्वोर्विशद धरिः ||
9.103.e: Shared by all Gods, Infallible, the Leader of our holy hymns,  Golden-hued Soma, being cleansed, hath reached the bowls.

9.103.d: परि दैवीरनु सवधा इन्द्रेण याहि सरथम | पुनानो वाघद वाघद्भिरमर्त्यः ||
9.103.e: After thy Godlike qualities, associate with Indra, go,  As a Priest purified by priests, Immortal One.

9.103.d: परि सप्तिर्न वाजयुर्देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः | वयानशिः पवमानो वि धावति ||
9.103.e: Like a car-horse who shows his strength, a God effused for Deities.  The penetrating Pavamana flows along.

9.104.d: सखाय आ नि शीदत पुनानाय पर गायत | शिशुं न यज्ञैः परि भूषत शरिये ||
9.104.e: SIT down, O friends, and sing aloud to him who purifies himself:  Deck him for glory, like a child, with holy rites.

9.104.d: समी वत्सं न मात्र्भिः सर्जता गयसाधनम | देवाव्यम्मदमभि दविशवसम ||
9.104.e: Unite him bringing household wealth, even as a calf, with mother kine,  Him who hath double strength, the God, delighting juice.

9.104.d: पुनाता दक्षसाधनं यथा शर्धाय वीतये | यथा मित्राय वरुणाय शन्तमः ||
9.104.e: Purify him who gives us power, that he, most Blessed One, may be  A banquet for the Troop, Mitra, and Varuṇa.

9.104.d: अस्मभ्यं तवा वसुविदमभि वाणीरनूषत | गोभिष टे वर्णमभि वासयामसि ||
9.104.e: Voices have sung aloud to thee as finderout of wealth for us:  We clothe the hue thou wearest with a robe of milk.

9.104.d: स नो मदानां पत इन्दो देवप्सरा असि | सखेव सख्ये गातुवित्तमो भव ||
9.104.e: Thou, Indu, art the food of Gods, O Sovran of all gladdening drinks:  As Friend for friend, be thou best finder of success.

9.104.d: सनेमि कर्ध्यस्मदा रक्षसं कं चिदत्रिणम | अपादेवं दवयुमंहो युयोधि नः ||
9.104.e: Drive utterly away from us each demon, each voracious fiend,  The godless and the false: keep sorrow far away.

9.105.d: तं वः सखायो मदाय पुनानमभि गायत | शिशुं न यज्ञैः सवदयन्त गूर्तिभिः ||
9.105.e: SING; ye aloud, O friends, to him who makes him pure for gladdening drink:  They shall make sweet the Child with sacrifice and laud.

9.105.d: सं वत्स इव मात्र्भिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते | देवावीर्मदोमतिभिः परिष्क्र्तः ||
9.105.e: Like as a calf with mother cows, so Indu is urged forth and sent,  Glorified by our hymns, the God-delighting juice.

9.105.d: अयं दक्षाय साधनो.अयं शर्धाय वीतये | अयं देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः सुतः ||
9.105.e: Effectual means of power is he, he is a banquet for the Troop,  He who hath been effused, most rich in meath, for Gods.

9.105.d: गोमन न इन्दो अश्ववत सुतः सुदक्ष धन्व | शुचिं ते वर्णमधि गोषु दीधरम ||
9.105.e: Flow to us, Indu, passing, strong, effused, with wealth of kine and steeds:  I will spread forth above the milk thy radiant hue.

9.105.d: स नो हरीणां पत इन्दो देवप्सरस्तमः | सखेव सख्ये नर्यो रुचे भव ||
9.105.e: Lord of the tawny, Indu thou who art the God's most special food,  As Friend to friend, for splendour be thou good to men.

9.105.d: सनेमि तवमस्मदानदेवं कं चिदत्रिणम | साह्वानिन्दो परि बाधो अप दवयुम ||
9.105.e: Drive utterly, far away from us each godless, each voracious foe.  O Indu, overcome and drive the false afar.

9.106.d: इन्द्रमछ सुता इमे वर्षणं यन्तु हरयः | शरुष्टी जातास इन्दवः सवर्विदः ||
9.106.e: To Indra, to the Mighty Steer, may these gold-coloured juices go,  Drops rapidly produced, that find the light of heaven.

9.106.d: अयं भराय सानसिरिन्द्राय पवते सुतः | सोमो जैत्रस्यचेतति यथा विदे ||
9.106.e: Effused, this juice victorious flows for Indra, for his maintenance.  Soma bethinks him of the Conqueror, as he knows.

9.106.d: अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा गराभं गर्भ्णीत सानसिम | वज्रंच वर्षणं भरत समप्सुजित ||
9.106.e: May Indra in his raptures gain from him the grasp that gathers spoil,  And, winning waters, wield the steerstrong thunderbolt.

9.106.d: पर धन्वा सोम जाग्र्विरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव | दयुमन्तं शुष्ममा भरा सवर्विदम ||
9.106.e: Flow vigilant for Indra, thou Soma, yea, Indu, run thou on:  Bring hither splendid strength that finds the light of heaven.

9.106.d: इन्द्राय वर्षणं मदं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः | सहस्रयामा पथिक्र्द विचक्षणः ||
9.106.e: Do thou, all-beautiful, purify for Indra's sake the mighty juice,  Path-maker thou, far seeing, with a thousand ways.

9.106.d: अस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमो देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः | सहस्रं याहिपथिभिः कनिक्रदत ||
9.106.e: Best finder of prosperity for us, most rich in sweets for Gods,  Proceed thou loudly roaring on a thousand paths.

9.106.d: पवस्व देववीतय इन्दो धाराभिरोजसा | आ कलशं मधुमान सोम नः सदः ||
9.106.e: O Indu, with thy streams, in might, flow for the banquet of the Gods:  Rich in meath, Soma, in our beaker take thy place.

9.106.d: तव दरप्सा उदप्रुत इन्द्रं मदाय वाव्र्धुः | तवां देवासो अम्र्ताय कं पपुः ||
9.106.e: Thy drops that swim in water have exalted Indra to delight:  The Gods have drunk thee up for immortality.

9.106.d: आ नः सुतास इन्दवः पुनाना धावता रयिम | वर्ष्टिद्यावोरीत्यापः सवर्विदः ||
9.106.e: Stream opulence to us, ye drops of Soma, pressed and purified,  Pouring down rain from heaven in hoods, and finding light.

9.106.d: सोमः पुनान ऊर्मिणाव्यो वारं वि धावति | अग्रे वाचःपवमानः कनिक्रदत ||
9.106.e: Soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep,  Shouting while purified before the voice of song.

9.106.d: धीभिर्हिन्वन्ति वाजिनं वने करीळन्तमत्यविम | अभि तरिप्र्ष्ठं मतयः समस्वरन ||
9.106.e: With songs they send the Mighty forth, sporting in wood, above the fleece:  Our psalms have glorified him of the triple height.

9.106.d: असर्जि कलशानभि मीळ्हे सप्तिर्न वाजयुः | पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यदत ||
9.106.e: Into the jars hath he been loosed, like an impetuous steed for war,  And lifting up his voice, while filtered, glided on.

9.106.d: पवते हर्यतो हरिरति हवरांसि रंह्या | अभ्यर्षन सतोत्र्भ्यो वीरवद यशः ||
9.106.e: Gold-hued and lovely in his course, througb tangles of the wool he flows,  And pours heroic fame upon the worshippers.

9.106.d: अया पवस्व देवयुर्मधोर्धारा अस्र्क्षत | रेभन पवित्रम्पर्येषि विश्वतः ||
9.106.e: Flow thus, a faithful votary: the streams of meath have been effused.  Thou comest to the filter, singing, from each side.

9.107.d: परीतो षिञ्चता सुतं सोमो य उत्तमं हविः | दधन्वान्यो नर्यो अप्स्वन्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः ||
9.107.e: I., HENCE sprinkle forth the juice effused,. Soma, the best of sacred gifts,  Who, friend of man, hath run amid the water-streams. He hath pressed Soma out with stones.

9.107.d: नूनं पुनानो.अविभिः परि सरवादब्धः सुरभिन्तरः | सुते चित तवाप्सु मदामो अन्धसा शरीणन्तो गोभिरुत्तरम ||
9.107.e: Now, being purified, flow hither through the fleece inviolate and most odorous.  We ladden thee in waters when thou art effused, blending thee still with juice and milk.

9.107.d: परि सुवानश्चक्षसे देवमादनः करतुरिन्दुर्विचक्षणः ||
9.107.e: Pressed out for all to see, delighting Gods, Indu, Far-sighted One, is mental power.

9.107.d: पुनानः सोम धारयापो वसानो अर्षसि | आ रत्नधा योनिम्र्तस्य सीदस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः ||
9.107.e: Cleansing thee, Soma, in thy stream, thou flowest in a watery robe:  Giver of wealth, thou sittest in the place of Law, O God, a fountain made of gold.

9.107.d: दुहान ऊधर्दिव्यं मधु परियं परत्नं सधस्थमासदत | आप्र्छ्यं धरुणं वाज्यर्षति नर्भिर्धूतो विचक्षणः ||
9.107.e: Milking the heavenly udder for dear meath, he hath sat in the ancient gatheringplace.  Washed by the men, the Strong Farseeing One streams forth nutriti us food that all desire.

9.107.d: पुनानः सोम जाग्र्विरव्यो वारे परि परियः | तवं विप्रोभवो.अङगिरस्तमो मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्ष नः ||
9.107.e: O Soma, while they cleanse thee, dear and watchful in the sheep's long wool,  Thou hast become a Singer most like Aṅgiras: thou madest Sūrya mount to heaven.

9.107.d: सोमो मीढ्वान पवते गातुवित्तम रषिर्विप्रो विचक्षणः | तवं कविरभवो देववीतम आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि ||
9.107.e: Bountiful, best of furtherers, Soma floweth on, Ṛṣi and Singer, keen of sight.  Thou hast become a Sage most welcome to the Gods: thou madest Sūrya mount to heaven.

9.107.d: सोम उ षुवाणः सोत्र्भिरधि षणुभिरवीनाम | अश्वयेवहरित याति धारया मन्द्रया याति धारया ||
9.107.e: Pressed out by pressers, Soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep,  Goes, even as with a mare, in tawnycoloured stream, goes in exhilarating stream.

9.107.d: अनूपे गोमान गोभिरक्षाः सोमो दुग्धाभिरक्षाः | समुद्रं न संवरणान्यग्मन मन्दी मदाय तोशते ||
9.107.e: Down to the water-Soma, rich in kine hath flowed with cows, with cows that have been milked.  They have approached the mixing-vessel as a sea: the cheerer streams for the carouse.

9.107.d: आ सोम सुवानो अद्रिभिस्तिरो वाराण्यव्यया | जनो न पुरि चम्वोर्विशद धरिः सदो वनेषु दधिषे ||
9.107.e: Effused by stones, O Soma, and urged through the long wool of the sheep,  Thou, entering the saucers as a man the fort, gold-hued hast settled in the wood.

9.107.d: स माम्र्जे तिरो अण्वानि मेष्यो मीळ्हे सप्तिर्न वजयुः | अनुमाद्यः पवमानो मनीषिभिः सोमो विप्रेभिरकवभिः ||
9.107.e: He beautifies himself through the sheep's long fine wool, like an impetuous steed in war,  Even Soma Pavamana who shall be the joy of sages and of holy bards.

9.107.d: पर सोम देववीतये सिन्धुर्न पिप्ये अर्णसा अंशोः पयसामदिरो न जाग्र्विरछा कोशं मधुश्चुतम ||
9.107.e: O Soma,—for the feast of Gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge,  With the stalk's juice, exhilarating, resting not, into the vat that drops with meath.

9.107.d: आ हर्यतो अर्जुने अत्के अव्यत परियः सूनुर्न मर्ज्यः | तमीं हिन्वन्त्यपसो यथा रथं नदीष्वा गभस्त्योः ||
9.107.e: Like a dear son who must be decked, the Lovely One hath clad him in a shining robe.  Men skilful at their work drive him forth, like a car, into the rivers from their bands.

9.107.d: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम | समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि मनीषिणो मत्सरासः सवर्विदः ||
9.107.e: The living drops of Soma juice pour, as they flow, the gladdening drink,  Intelligent drops above the basin of the sea, exhilarating, finding light.

9.107.d: तरत समुद्रं पवमान ऊर्मिणा राजा देव रतं बर्हत | अर्षन मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धर्मणा पर हिन्वान रतं बर्हत ||
9.107.e: May Pavamana, King and God, speed with his wave over the sea the lofty rite:  May he by Mitra's and by Varuṇa's decree flow furthering the lofty rite.

9.107.d: नर्भिर्येमानो हर्यतो विचक्षणो राजा देवः समुद्रियः ||
9.107.e: Far-seeing, lovely, guided by the men, the God whose home is in the sea-

9.107.d: इन्द्राय पवते मदः सोमो मरुत्वते सुतः | सहस्रधारो अत्यव्यमर्षति तमीं मर्जन्त्यायवः ||
9.107.e: Soma, the gladdening juice, flows pressed for Indra with his Marut host:  He hastens o’er the fleece with all his thousand streams: men make him bright and beautiful.

9.107.d: पुनानश्चमू जनयन मतिं कविः सोमो देवेषु रण्यति | अपो वसानः परि गोभिरुत्तरः सीदन वनेष्वव्यत ||
9.107.e: Purified in the bowl and gendering the hymn, wise Soma joys among the Gods.  Robed in the flood, the Mighty One hath clad himself with milk and settled in the vats.

9.107.d: तवाहं सोम रारण सख्य इन्दो दिवे-दिवे | पुरूणि बभ्रो नि चरन्ति मामव परिधीन्रति तानिहि ||
9.107.e: O Soma, Indu, every day thy friendship hath been my delight.  Many fiends follow me; help me, thou Tawny-hued; pass on beyond these barriers.

9.107.d: उताहं नक्तमुत सोम ते दिवा सख्याय बभ्र ऊधनि | घर्णा तपन्तमति सूर्यं परः शकुना इव पप्तिम ||
9.107.e: Close to thy bosom am I, Soma, day and night. O Tawny-hued, for friendship sake.  Sūrya himself refulgent with his glow have we o’ertaken in his course like birds.

9.107.d: मर्ज्यमानः सुहस्त्य समुद्रे वाचमिन्वसि | रयिं पिशन्गं बहुलं पुरुस्प्र्हं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि ||
9.107.e: Deft-handcd! thou when purified liftest thy voice amid the sea.  Thou, Pavamana, makest riches flow to us, yellow, abundant, much-desifed.

9.107.d: मर्जानो वारे पवमनो अव्यये वर्षाव चक्रदो वने | देवानां सोम पवमान निष्क्र्तं गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षसि ||
9.107.e: Making thee pure and bright in the sheep's long wool, thou hast bellowed, steerlike, in the wood.  Thou flowest, Soma Pavamana, balmed with milk unto the special place of Gods.

9.107.d: पवस्व वाजसातये.अभि विश्वानि काव्या | तवं समुद्रं परथमो वि धारयो देवेभ्यः सोम मत्सरः ||
9.107.e: Flow on to win us strength, flow on to lofty lore of every kind.  Thou, Soma, as Exhilarator wast the first to spread the sea abroad for Gods.

9.107.d: स तू पवस्व परि पार्थिवं रजो दिव्या च सोम धर्मभिः | तवां विप्रासो मतिभिर्विचक्षण शुभ्रं हिन्वन्ति धीतिभिः ||
9.107.e: Flow to the realm of earth, flow to the realm of heaven, O Soma, in thy righteous ways.  Fair art thou whom the sages, O Far-seeing One, urge onward with their songs and hymns.

9.107.d: पवमाना अस्र्क्षत पवित्रमति धारया | मरुत्वन्तो मत्सरा इन्द्रिया हया मेधामभि परयांसि च ||
9.107.e: Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Pavamanas in a stream,  Girt by the Maruts, gladdening, Steeds with Indra's stiength, for wisdom and for dainty food.

9.107.d: अपो वसानः परि कोशमर्षतिन्दुर्हियानः सोत्र्भिः | जनयञ जयोतिर्मन्दना अवीवशद गाः कर्ण्वानो न निर्णिजम ||
9.107.e: Urged onward by the pressers, clad in watery robes, Indu is speeding to the vat.  He gendering light, hath made the glad Cows low, while he takes them as his garb of state.

9.108.d: पवस्व मधुमत्तम इन्द्राय सोम करतुवित्तमो मदः | महि दयुक्षतमो मदः ||
9.108.e: FOR Indra, flow thou Soma on, as gladdening juice most sweet, intelligent,  Great, cheering, dwelling most in heaven.

9.108.d: यस्य ते पीत्वा वर्षभो वर्षायते.अस्य पीता सवर्विदः | स सुप्रकेतो अभ्यक्रमीदिशो.अछा वाजं नैतशः ||
9.108.e: Thou, of whom having drunk the Steer acts like a steer. drinking of this that finds the light,  He, Excellently Wise, is come to strengthening food, to spoil and wealth like Etaśa.

9.108.d: तवं हयन्ग दैव्या पवमान जनिमानि दयुमत्तमः | अम्र्तत्वाय घोषयः ||
9.108.e: For, verily, Pavamana, thou hast, splendidest, called all the generations of  The Gods to immortality.

9.108.d: येना नवग्वो दध्यन्नपोर्णुते येन विप्रास आपिरे | देवानां सुम्ने अम्र्तस्य चारुणो येन शरवांस्यानशुः ||
9.108.e: By whom Dadhyac Navagva opens fastened doors, by whom the sages gained their wish,  By whom they won the fame of lovely Amṛta in the felicity of Gods.

9.108.d: एष सय धारया सुतो.अव्यो वारेभिः पवते मदिन्तमः | करीळन्नूर्मिरपामिव ||
9.108.e: Effused, he floweth in a stream, best rapture-giver, in the long wool of the sheep,  Sporting, as ’twere the waters' wave.

9.108.d: य उस्रिया अप्या अन्तरश्मनो निर्गा अक्र्न्तदोजसा | अभिव्रजं तत्निषे गव्यमश्व्यं वर्मीव धर्ष्णवा रुज ||
9.108.e: He who from out the rocky cavern took with might the redmrefulgent watery Cows,  Thou masterest the stable full of kine and steeds: burst it, brave Lord, like one in mail.

9.108.d: आ सोता परि षिञ्चताश्वं न सतोममप्तुरं रजस्तुरम | वनर्क्षमुदप्रुतम ||
9.108.e: Press ye and pour him, like a steed, laudworthy, speeding through the region and the flood,  Who swims in water, roan in wood;

9.108.d: सहस्रधारं वर्षभं पयोव्र्धं परियं देवाय जन्मने | रतेन य रतजातो विवाव्र्धे राजा देव रतं बर्हत ||
9.108.e: Increaser of the water, Steer with thousand streams, dear to the race of Deities;  Who born in Law hath waxen mighty by the Law, King, God, and lofty Ordinance.

9.108.d: अभि दयुम्नं बर्हद यश इषस पते दिदीहि देव देवयुः | विकोशं मध्यमं युव ||
9.108.e: Make splendid glory shine on us, thou Lord of strengthening food, God, as the Friend of Gods:  Unclose the fount of middle air.

9.108.d: आ वच्यस्व सुदक्ष चम्वोः सुतो विशां वह्निर्न विश्पतिः | वर्ष्टिं दिवः पवस्व रीतिमपां जिन्वा गविष्टये धियः ||
9.108.e: Roll onward to the bowls, O Mighty One, effused, as Prince supporter of the tribes.  Pour on us rain from heaven, send us the waters' flow: incite our thoughts to win the spoil.

9.108.d: एतमु तयं मदच्युतं सहस्रधारं वर्षभं दिवो दुहुः | विश्वा वसूनि बिभ्रतम ||
9.108.e: They have drained him the Steer of heaven, him with a thousand streams, distilling rapturous joy,  Him who brings all things excellent.

9.108.d: वर्षा वि जज्ञे जनयन्नमर्त्यः परतपञ जयोतिषा तमः | स सुष्टुतः कविभिर्निर्णिजं दधे तरिधात्वस्य दंससा ||
9.108.e: The Mighty One was born Immortal, giving life, lightening darkness with his shine.  Wcll-praised by. sages he hath. by his wondrous power assumed the Threefold as his robe.

9.108.d: स सुन्वे यो वसूनां यो रायामानेता य इळानाम | सोमोयः सुक्षितीनाम ||
9.108.e: Effused is he who brings good things, who brings us bounteous gifts and sweet refreshing food,  Soma who brings us quiet homes:

9.108.d: यस्य न इन्द्रः पिबाद यस्य मरुतो यस्य वार्यमणा भगः | आ येन मित्रावरुणा करामह एन्द्रमवसे महे ||
9.108.e: He whom our Indra and the Marut host shall drink, Bhaga shall drink with Aryarnan,  By whom we bring to us Mitra and Varuṇa and Indra for our great defence.

9.108.d: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे नर्भिर्यतः सवायुधो मदिन्तमः | पवस्व मधुमत्तमः ||
9.108.e: Soma, for Indra's drink do thou, led by the men, well-wcaponcd and most gladdening,  Flow on with greatest store of sweets.

9.108.d: इन्द्रस्य हार्दि सोमधानमा विश समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः | जुष्टो मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे दिवो विष्टम्भ उत्तमः ||
9.108.e: Enter the Soma-holder, even Indra's heart, as rivers pass into the sea,  Acceptable to Mitra, Vāyu, Varuṇa, the noblest Pillar of the heavens.

9.109.d: परि पर धन्वेन्द्राय सोम सवादुर मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय ||
9.109.e: PLEASANT to Indra's Mitra's, Pūṣan's Bhaga's taste, sped onward, Soma, with thy flowing stream.

9.109.d: इन्द्रस ते सोम सुतस्य पेयाः करत्वे दक्षाय विश्वे च देवाः ||
9.109.e: Let Indra drink, O Soma, of thy juice for wisdom, and all Deities for strength.

9.109.d: एवाम्र्ताय महे कषयाय स शुक्रो अर्ष दिव्यः पीयूषः ||
9.109.e: So flow thou on as bright celestial juice, flow to the vast, immortal dwelling-place.

9.109.d: पवस्व सोम महान समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम ||
9.109.e: Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods to every form.

9.109.d: शुक्रः पवस्व देवेभ्यः सोम दिवे पर्थिव्यै शं च परजायै ||
9.109.e: Flow on, O Soma, radiant for the Gods and Heaven and Earth and bless our progeny.

9.109.d: दिवो धर्तासि शुक्रः पीयूषः सत्ये विधर्मन वाजी पवस्व ||
9.109.e: Thou, bright Juice, art Sustainer of the sky: flow, mighty, in accordance with true Law.

9.109.d: पवस्व सोम दयुम्नी सुधारो महाम अवीनाम अनु पूर्व्यः ||
9.109.e: Soma, flow splendid with thy copious stream through the great fleece as in the olden time.

9.109.d: नर्भिर येमानो जज्ञानः पूतः कषरद विश्वानि मन्द्रः सवर्वित ||
9.109.e: Bom, led by men, joyous, and purified, let the Light-finder make all blessings flow:

9.109.d: इन्दुः पुनानः परजाम उराणः करद विश्वानि दरविणानि नः ||
9.109.e: Indu, while cleansed, keeping the people safe, shall give us all possessions for our own.

9.109.d: पवस्व सोम करत्वे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय ||
9.109.e: Flow on for wisdom, Soma, and for power, as a strong courser bathed, to win the prize.

9.109.d: तं ते सोतारो रसम मदाय पुनन्ति सोमम महे दयुम्नाय ||
9.109.e: The pressers purify this juice of thine, the Soma, for delight, and lofty fame

9.109.d: शिशुं जज्ञानं हरिम मर्जन्ति पवित्रे सोमं देवेभ्य इन्दुम ||
9.109.e: They deck the Gold-hued Infant, newlyborn, even Soma, Indu, in the sieve for Gods.

9.109.d: इन्दुः पविष्ट चारुर मदायापाम उपस्थे कविर भगाय ||
9.109.e: Fair Indu hath flowed on for rapturous joy, Sage for good fortune in the waters' lap.

9.109.d: बिभर्ति चार्व इन्द्रस्य नाम येन विश्वानि वर्त्रा जघान ||
9.109.e: He bears the beauteous name of Indra, that wherewith he overcame all demon foes.

9.109.d: पिबन्त्य अस्य विश्वे देवासो गोभिः शरीतस्य नर्भिः सुतस्य ||
9.109.e: All Deities are wont to drink of him, pressed by the men and blent with milk and curds.

9.109.d: पर सुवानो अक्षाः सहस्रधारस तिरः पवित्रं वि वारम अव्यम ||
9.109.e: He hath flowed forth with thousand streams effused, flowed ihsough the filter and the sheep's long wool.

9.109.d: स वाज्य अक्षाः सहस्ररेता अद्भिर मर्जानो गोभिः शरीणानः ||
9.109.e: With endless genial flow the Strong hath run, purified by the waters, blent with milk.

9.109.d: पर सोम याहीन्द्रस्य कुक्षा नर्भिर येमानो अद्रिभिः सुतः ||
9.109.e: Pressed out with stones, directed by the men, go fortli, O Soma, into Indra's throat.

9.109.d: असर्जि वाजी तिरः पवित्रम इन्द्राय सोमः सहस्रधारः ||
9.109.e: The mighty Soma with a thousand streams is poured to Indra through the cleansing sieve.

9.109.d: अञ्जन्त्य एनम मध्वो रसेनेन्द्राय वर्ष्ण इन्दुम मदाय ||
9.109.e: Indu they balm with pleasant milky juice for Indra, for the Steer, for his delight.

9.109.d: देवेभ्यस तवा वर्था पाजसे ऽपो वसानं हरिम मर्जन्ति ||
9.109.e: Lightly, for sheen, they cleanse thee for the Gods, gold-coloured, wearing water as thy robe.

9.109.d: इन्दुर इन्द्राय तोशते नि तोशते शरीणन्न उग्रो रिणन्न अपः ||
9.109.e: Indu to Indra streams, yea, downward streams, Strong, flowing to the floods, and mingling -there.

9.110.d: पर्यू षु पर धन्व वाजसातये परि वर्त्राणि सक्षणिः | दविषस्तरध्या रणया न ईयसे ||
9.110.e: O'ERPOWERING Vṛtras, forward run to win great strength:  Thou speedest to subdue like one exacting debts.

9.110.d: अनु हि तवा सुतं सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये | वाजानभि पवमान पर गाहसे ||
9.110.e: In thee, effused, O Soma, we rejoice ourselves for great supremacy in fight.  Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds,

9.110.d: अजीजनो हि पवमान सूर्यं विधारे शक्मना पयः | गोजीरया रंहमानः पुरन्ध्या ||
9.110.e: O Pavamana, thou didst generate the Sun, and spread the moisture out with power,  Hasting to us with plenty vivified with milk.

9.110.d: अजीजनो अम्र्त मर्त्येष्वा रतस्य धर्मन्नम्र्तस्य चारुणः | सदासरो वाजमछा सनिष्यदत ||
9.110.e: Thou didst produce him, Deathless God mid mortal men for maintenance of Law and lovely Amṛta:  Thou evermore hast moved making strength flow to us.

9.110.d: अभ्य-अभि हि शरवसा ततर्दिथोत्सं न कं चिज्जनपानमक्षितम | शर्याभिर्न भरमाणो गभस्त्योः ||
9.110.e: All round about hast thou with glory pierced for us as ’twere a never-failing well for men to drink,  Borne on thy way in fragments from the presser's arms.

9.110.d: आदीं के चित पश्यमानास आप्यं वसुरुचो दिव्या अभ्यनूषत | वारं न देवः सविता वयूर्णुते ||
9.110.e: Then, beautifully radiant, certain Heavenly Ones, have sung to him their kinship as they looked thereon,  And Savitar the God opens as ’twere a stall.

9.110.d: तवे सोम परथमा वर्क्तबर्हिषो महे वाजाय शरवसे धियन्दधुः | स तवं नो वीर वीर्याय चोदय ||
9.110.e: Soma, the men of old whose grass was trimmed addressed the hymn to thee for mighty strength and for renown:  So, Hero, urge us onward to heroic power.

9.110.d: दिवः पीयूषं पूर्व्यं यदुक्थ्यं महो गाहाद दिव आनिरधुक्षत | इन्द्रमभि जायमानं समस्वरन ||
9.110.e: They have drained forth from out the great depth of the sky the old primeval milk of heaven that claims the laud:  They lifted up their voice to Indra athis birth.

9.110.d: अध यदिमे पवमान रोदसी इमा च विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मना | यूथे न निष्ठा वर्षभो वि तिष्ठसे ||
9.110.e: As long as thou, O Pavamana, art above this earth and heaven and all existence in thy might,  Thou standest like a Bull the chief amid the herd.

9.110.d: सोमः पुनानो अव्यये वारे शिशुर्न करीळन पवमानो अक्षाः | सहस्रधारः शतवाज इन्दुः ||
9.110.e: In the sheep's wool hath Soma Pavamana flowed, while they cleanse him, like a playful infant,  Indu with hundred powers and hundred currents.

9.110.d: एष पुनानो मधुमान रतावेन्द्रायेन्दुः पवते सवादुरूर्मिः | वाजसनिर्वरिवोविद वयोधाः ||
9.110.e: Holy and sweet, while purified, this Indu flows on, a wave of pleasant taste, to Indra,—  Strength-winner, Treasure-finder, Life. bestower.

9.110.d: स पवस्व सहमानः पर्तन्यून सेधन रक्षांस्यप दुर्गहाणि | सवायुधः सासह्वान सोम शत्रून ||
9.110.e: So flow thou on, subduing our assailants, chasing the demons hard to beencountered,  Well-armed and conquering our foes, O Soma.

9.111.d: अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा दवेषांसि तरति सवयुग्वभिः सूरो न सवयुग्वभिः | धारा सुतस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः | विश्वा यद रूपा परियात्य रक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिरकवभिः ||
9.111.e: WITH this his golden splendour purifying him, he with his own allies subdues all enemies, as Sara with his own allies.  Cleansing himself with stream of juice he shines forth yellow-hued and red, when with the praisers he encompasses all forms, with praisers having seven mouths.

9.111.d: तवं तयत पणीनां विदो वसु सं मात्र्भिर्मर्जयसि सव आ दम रतस्य धीतिभिर्दमे | परावतो न साम तद यत्रारणन्ति धीतयः | तरिधातुभिररुषीभिर्वयो दधे रोचमानो वयो दधे ||
9.111.e: That treasure of the Paṇis thou discoveredst; thou with thy mothers deckest thee in thine abode, with songs of worship in thine home.  As ’twere from far, the hymn is heard, where holy songs resound in joy. He with the ruddy-hued, threefold hath won life-power, he, glittering, hath won life-power.

9.111.d: पूर्वामनु परदिशं याति चेकितत सं रश्मिभिर्यतते दर्शतो रथो दैव्यो दर्शतो रथः | अग्मन्नुक्थानि पौंस्येन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षयन | वज्रश्च यद भवथो अनपच्युतासमत्स्वनपच्युता ||
9.111.e: He moves intelligent, directed to the East. The very beauteous car rivals the beams of light, the beautiful celestial car.  Hymns, lauding manly valour, came, inciting Indra to success, that ye may be unconquered, both thy bolt and thou, both be unconquered in the war.

9.112.d: नानानं वा उ नो धियो वि वरतानि जनानाम | तक्षा रिष्टं रुतं भिषग बरह्मा सुन्वन्तमिछतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.112.e: WE all have various thoughts and plans, and diverse are the ways of men.  The Brahman seeks the worshipper, wright seeks the cracked, and leech the maimed. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.112.d: जरतीभिरोषधीभिः पर्णेभिः शकुनानाम | कार्मारो अश्मभिर्द्युभिर्हिरण्यवन्तमिछतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.112.e: The smith with ripe and seasoned plants, with feathers of the birds of air,  With stones, and with enkindled flames, seeks him who hath a store of gold. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.112.d: कारुरहं ततो भिषगुपलप्रक्षिणी नना | नानाधियोवसूयवो.अनु गा इव तस्थिमेन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.112.e: A bard am I, my dad's a leech, mammy lays corn upon the stones.  Striving for wealth, with varied plans, we follow our desires like kine. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.112.d: अश्वो वोळ्हा सुखं रथं हसनामुपमन्त्रिणः | शेपो रोमण्वन्तौ भेदौ वारिन मण्डूक इछतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.112.e: The horse would draw an easy car, gay hosts attract the laugh and jest.  The male desires his mate's approach, the frog is eager for the flood, Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.113.d: शर्यणावति सोममिन्द्रः पिबतु वर्त्रहा | बलं दधान आत्मनि करिष्यन वीर्यं महदिन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.113.e: LET Vṛtra-slaying Indra drink Soma by Śaryaṇāvān's side,  Storing up vigour in his heart, prepared to do heroic deeds. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.113.d: आ पवस्व दिशां पत आर्जीकात सोम मीढ्वः | रतवाकेन सत्येन शरद्धया तपसा सुत इन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.113.e: Lord of the Quarters, flow thou on, boon Soma, from Arjika land,  Effused with ardour and with faith, and the true hymn of sacrifice. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.113.d: पर्जन्यव्र्द्धं महिषं तं सूर्यस्य दुहिताभरत | तं गन्धर्वाः परत्यग्र्भ्णन तं सोमे रसमादधुरिन्द्रायेन्दोपरि सरव ||
9.113.e: Hither hath Sūrya's Daughter brought the wild Steer whom Parjanya nursed.  Gandharvas have seized bold of him, and in the Soma laid the juice. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.113.d: रतं वदन्न्र्तद्युम्न सत्यं वदन सत्यकर्मन | शरद्धां वदन सोम राजन धात्रा सोम परिष्क्र्त इन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.113.e: Splendid by Law! declaring Law, truthspeaking, truthful in thy works,  Enouncing faith, King Soma! thou, O Soma, whom thy maker decks. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.113.d: सत्यमुग्रस्य बर्हतः सं सरवन्ति संस्रवाः | सं यन्ति रसिनो रसाः पुनानो बरह्मणा हर इन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.113.e: Together flow the meeting streams of him the Great and truly Strong.  The juices of the juicy meet. Made pure by prayer, O Golden-hued, flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.113.d: यत्र बरह्मा पवमान छन्दस्यां वाचं वदन | गराव्णा सोमे महीयते सोमेनानन्दं जनयन्निन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.113.e: O Pavamana, where the priest, as he recites the rhythmic prayer,  Lords it o’er Soma with the stone, with Soma bringing forth delight, flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.113.d: यत्र जयोतिरजस्रं यस्मिन लोके सवर्हितम | तस्मिन मां धेहि पवमानाम्र्ते लोके अक्षित इन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.113.e: O Pavarnana, place me in that deathless, undecaying world  Wherein the light of heaven is set, and everlasting lustre shines. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.113.d: यत्र राजा वैवस्वतो यत्रावरोधनं दिवः | यत्रामूर्यह्वतीरापस्तत्र मामम्र्तं कर्धीन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.113.e: Make me immortal in that realm where dwells the King, Vivasvān's Son,  Where is the secret shrine of heaven, where are those waters young and fresh. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.113.d: यत्रानुकामं चरणं तरिनाके तरिदिवे दिवः | लोका यत्र जयोतिष्मन्तस्तत्र मामम्र्तं कर्धीन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.113.e: Make me immortal in that realm where they move even as they list,  In the third sphere of inmost heaven where lucid worlds are full of light. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.113.d: यत्र कामा निकामाश्च यत्र बरध्नस्य विष्टपम | सवधा च यत्र तर्प्तिश्च तत्र मामम्र्तं कर्धीन्द्रायेन्दो परिस्रव ||
9.113.e: Make me immortal in that realm of eager wish and strong desire,  The region of the radiant Moon, where food and full delight are found. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake:

9.113.d: यत्रानन्दाश्च मोदाश्च मुदः परमुद आसते | कामस्य यत्राप्ताः कामास्तत्र मामम्र्तं कर्धीन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.113.e: Make me immortal in that realm where happiness and transports, where  Joys and felicities combine, and longing wishes are fulfilled. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.114.d: य इन्दोः पवमानस्यानु धामान्यक्रमीत | तमाहुः सुप्रजा इति यस्ते सोमाविधन मन इन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.114.e: THE man who waIketh as the Laws of Indu Pavamana bid,—  Men call him rich in children, him, O Soma, who hath met thy thought. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.114.d: रषे मन्त्रक्र्तां सतोमैः कश्यपोद्वर्धयन गिरः | सोमंनमस्य राजानं यो जज्ञे वीरुधां पतिरिन्द्रायेन्दो परिस्रव ||
9.114.e: Kasyapa, Ṛṣi, lifting up thy voice with hymn-composers' lauds,  Pav reverence to King Soma born the Sovran Ruler of the plants. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.114.d: सप्त दिशो नानासूर्याः सप्त होतार रत्विजः | देवा आदित्या ये सप्त तेभिः सोमाभि रक्ष न इन्द्रयेन्दो परि सरव ||
9.114.e: Seven regions have their several Suns; the ministering priests are seven;  Seven are the Āditya Deities,—with these, O Soma, guard thou us. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

9.114.d: यत ते राजञ्छ्र्तं हविस्तेन सोमाभि रक्ष नः | अरातीवा मा नस्तारीन मो च नः किं चनाममदिन्द्रायेन्दो परिस्रव ||
9.114.e: Guard us with this oblation which, King Soma, hath been dressed for thee.

10.1.d: अग्रे बर्हन्नुषसामूर्ध्वो अस्थान निर्जगन्वान तमसोज्योतिषागात | अग्निर्भानुना रुशता सवङग आ जातोविश्वा सद्मान्यप्राः ||
10.1.e: HIGH hath the Mighty risen before the dawning, and come to us with light from out the darkness.  Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.

10.1.d: स जातो गर्भो असि रोदस्योरग्ने चारुर्विभ्र्त ओषधीषु | चित्रः शिशुः परि तमांस्यक्तून पर मात्र्भ्यो अधिकनिक्रदत गाः ||
10.1.e: Thou, being born, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted among the plants in beauty, Agni!  The glooms of night thou, Brilliant Babe, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from thy Mothers.

10.1.d: विष्णुरित्था परममस्य विद्वाञ जातो बर्हन्नभि पातित्र्तीयम | आसा यदस्य पयो अक्रत सवं सचेतसो अभ्यर्चन्त्यत्र ||
10.1.e: Here, being manifested, lofty Viṣṇu, full wise, protects his own supremest station.  When they have offered in his mouth their sweet milk, to him with one accord they sing forth praises.

10.1.d: अत उ तवा पितुभ्र्तो जनित्रीरन्नाव्र्धं परति चरन्त्यन्नैः | ता ईं परत्येषि पुनरन्यरूपा असि तवं विक्षुमानुषीषु होता ||
10.1.e: Thence bearing food the Mothers come to meet thee, with food for thee who givest food its increase.  These in their altered form again thou meetest. Thou art Invoking Priest in homes of mortals.

10.1.d: होतारं चित्ररथमध्वरस्य यज्ञस्य-यज्ञस्य केतुंरुशन्तम | परत्यर्धिं देवस्य-देवस्य मह्ना शरिया तवग्निमतिथिं जनानाम ||
10.1.e: Priest of the holy rite, with car that glitters, refulgent Banner of each act of worship,  Sharinging every God through might and glory, even Agni Guest of men I summon hither.

10.1.d: स तु वस्त्राण्यध पेशनानि वसानो अग्निर्नाभाप्र्थिव्याः | अरुषो जातः पद इळायाः पुरोहितो राजन्यक्षीह देवान ||
10.1.e: So Agni stands on earth's most central station, invested in well-decorated garments.  Born, red of hue, where men pour out libations, O King, as great High Priest bring the Gods hither.

10.1.d: आ हि दयावाप्र्थिवी अग्न उभे सदा पुत्रो न मातराततन्थ | पर याह्यछोशतो यविष्ठाथा वह सहस्येहदेवान ||
10.1.e: Over the earth and over heaven, O Agni, thou, Son, hast ever spread above thy Parents.  Come, Youthfullest! to those who long to meet thee, and hither bring the Gods, O Mighty Victor.

10.2.d: पिप्रीहि देवानुशतो यविष्ठ विद्वान रतून्रतुपतेयजेह | ये दैव्या रत्विजस्तेभिरग्ने तवं होतॄणामस्यायजिष्ठः ||
10.2.e: GLADDEN the yearning Gods, O thou Most Youthful: bring them, O Lord of Seasons, knowing seasons,  With all the Priests Celestial, O Agni. Best worshipper art thou of all Invokers.

10.2.d: वेषि होत्रमुत पोत्रं जनानां मन्धातासि दरविणोदार्तावा | सवाहा वयं कर्णवामा हवींषि देवो देवान्यजत्वग्निरर्हन ||
10.2.e: Thine is the Herald's, thine the Cleanser's office, thinker art thou, wealth-giver, true to Order.  Let us with Svāhā offer up oblations, and Agni, worthy God, pay the Gods worship.

10.2.d: आ देवानामपि पन्थामगन्म यच्छक्नवाम तदनुप्रवोळुम | अग्निर्विद्वान स यजात सेदु होता सो अध्वरांस रतून कल्पयाति ||
10.2.e: To the Gods’ pathway have we travelled, ready to execute what work we may accomplish.  Let Agni, for he knows, complete the worship. He is the Priest: let him fix rites and seasons.

10.2.d: यद वो वयं परमिनाम वरतानि विदुषं देवाविदुष्टरासः | अग्निष टद विश्वमा पर्णाति विद्वान्येभिर्देवान रतुभिः कल्पयाति ||
10.2.e: When we most ignorant neglect the statutes of you, O Deities with whom is knowledge,  Wise Agni shall correct our faults and failings, skilled to assign each God his fitting season.

10.2.d: यत पाकत्रा मनसा दीनदक्षा न यज्ञस्य मन्वतेमर्त्यासः | अग्निष टद धोता करतुविद विजानन्यजिष्ठो देवान रतुशो यजाति ||
10.2.e: When, weak in mind, of feeble understanding, mortals bethink them not of sacrificing,  Then shall the prudent and discerning Agni worship the Gods, best worshipper, in season.

10.2.d: विश्वेषां हयध्वराणामनीकं चित्रं केतुं जनितात्वा जजान | स आ यजस्व नर्वतीरनु कषा सपार्हािषः कषुमतीर्विश्वजन्याः ||
10.2.e: Because the Father hath produced thee, Leader of all our solemn rites, their brilliant Banner:  So win by worship pleasant homes abounding in heroes, and rich food to nourish all men.

10.2.d: यं तवा दयावाप्र्थिवी यं तवापस्त्वष्टा यं तवासुजनिमा जजान | पन्थामनु परविद्वान्पित्र्याणं दयुमदग्ने समिधानो वि भाहि ||
10.2.e: Thou whom the Heaven and Earth, thou whom the Waters, and Tvaṣṭar, maker of fair things, created,  Well knowing, all along the Fathers' pathway, shine with resplendent light, enkindled, Agni.

10.3.d: इनो राजन्नरतिः समिद्धो रौद्रो दक्षाय सुषुमानदर्शि | चिकिद वि भाति भासा बर्हतासिक्नीमेति रुशतीमपाजन ||
10.3.e: O KING, the potent and terrific envoy, kindled for strength, is manifest in beauty.  He shines, all-knowing, with his lotty splendour: chasing black Night he comes with white-rayed Morning.

10.3.d: कर्ष्णां यदेनीमभि वर्पसा भूज्जनयन योषाम्ब्र्हतः पितुर्जाम | ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सूर्यस्य सतभायन्दिवो वसुभिररतिर्वि भाति ||
10.3.e: Having o’ercome the glimmering Black with beauty, and bringing forth the dame the Great Sire's Daughter,  Holding aloft the radiant light of Sūrya, as messenger of heaven he shines with treasures.

10.3.d: भद्रो भद्रया सचमान आगात सवसारं जारो अभ्येतिपश्चात | सुप्रकेतैर्द्युभिरग्निर्वितिष्ठन रुशद्भिर्वर्णैरभि राममस्थात ||
10.3.e: Attendant on the Blessed Dame the Blessed hath come: the Lover followeth his Sister.  Agni, far-spreading with conspicuous lustre, hath compassed Night with whitelyshining garments.

10.3.d: अस्य यामासो बर्हतो न वग्नूनिन्धाना अग्नेः सख्युःशिवस्य | इड्यस्य वर्ष्णो बर्हतः सवासो भामासो यामन्नक्तवश्चिकित्रे ||
10.3.e: His goings-forth kindle as ’twere high voices the goings of the auspicious Friend of Agni.  The rays, the bright beams of the strong-jawed, mighty, adorable Steer are visible as he cometh.

10.3.d: सवना न यस्य भामासः पवन्ते रोचमानस्य बर्हतःसुदिवः | जयेष्ठेभिर्यस्तेजिष्ठैः करीळुमद्भिर्वर्षिष्ठेभिर्भानुभिर्नक्षति दयाम ||
10.3.e: Whose radiant splendours flow, like sounds, about us, his who is lofty, brilliant, and effulgent,  Who reaches heaven with best and brightest lustres, sportive and piercing even to the summit.

10.3.d: अस्य शुष्मासो दद्र्शानपवेर्जेहमानस्य सवनयन नियुद्भिः | परत्नेभिर्यो रुशद्भिर्देवतमो वि रेभद्भिररतिर्भाति विभ्वा ||
10.3.e: His powers, whose chariot fellies gleam and glitter have loudly roared while, as with teams, he hasted.  He, the most Godlike, far-extending envoy, shines with flames ancient, resonant, whitely-shining.

10.3.d: स आ वक्षि महि न आ च सत्सि दिवस्प्र्थिव्योररतिर्युवत्योः | अग्निः सुतुकः सुतुकेभिरश्वै रभस्वद्भीरभस्वानेह गम्याः ||
10.3.e: So bring us ample wealth: seat thee as envoy of the two youthful Matrons, Earth and Heaven.  Let Agni rapid with his rapid, horses, impetuous with impetuous Steeds, come hither.

10.4.d: पर ते यक्षि पर त इयर्मि मन्म भुवो यथा वन्द्यो नोहवेषु | धन्वन्निव परपा असि तवमग्न इयक्षवे पूरवेप्रत्न राजन ||
10.4.e: To thee will send praise and bring oblation, as thou hast merited lauds when we invoked thee.  A fountain in the desert art thou, Agni, O Ancient King, to man who fain would worship,

10.4.d: यं तवा जनासो अभि संचरन्ति गाव उष्णमिव वरजंयविष्ठ | दूतो देवानामसि मर्त्यानामन्तर्महांश्चरसि रोचनेन ||
10.4.e: Thou unto whom resort the gathered people, as the kine seek the warm stall, O Most Youthful.  Thou art the messenger of Gods and mortals, and goest glorious with thy light between them.

10.4.d: शिशुं न तवा जेन्यं वर्धयन्ती माता बिभर्तिसचनस्यमाना | धनोरधि परवता यासि हर्यञ जिगीषसेपशुरिवावस्र्ष्टः ||
10.4.e: Making thee grow as ’twere some noble infant, thy Mother nurtures thee with sweet affection.  Over the desert slopes thou passest longing, and seekest, like some beast set free, thy fodder.

10.4.d: मूरा अमूर न वयं चिकित्वो महित्वमग्ने तवमङग वित्से | शये वव्रिश्चरति जिह्वयादन रेरिह्यते युवतिंविश्पतिः सन ||
10.4.e: Foolish are we, O Wise and free from error: verily, Agni, thou dost know thy grandeur.  There lies the form: he moves and licks, and swallows, and, as House-Lord, kisses the Youthful Maiden.

10.4.d: कूचिज्जायते सनयासु नव्यो वने तस्थौ पलितो धूमकेतुः | अस्नातापो वर्षभो न पर वेति सचेतसो यं पर्णयन्तमर्ताः ||
10.4.e: He rises ever fresh in ancient fuel: smoke-bannered, gray, he makes the wood his dwelling.  No swimmer, Steer, he presses through the waters, and to his place accordant mortals bear him.

10.4.d: तनूत्यजेव तस्करा वनर्गु रशनाभिर्दशभिरभ्यधीताम | इयं ते अग्ने नव्यसी मनीषा युक्ष्वा रथंन शुचयद्भिरङगैः ||
10.4.e: Like thieves who risk their lives and haunt the forest, the twain with their ten girdles have secured him.  This is a new hymn meant for thee, O Agni: yoke as it were thy car with parts that glitter.

10.4.d: बरह्म च ते जातवेदो नमश्चेयं च गीः सदमिद्वर्धनी भूत | रक्षा णो अग्ने तनयानि तोका रक्षोत नस्तन्वो अप्रयुछन ||
10.4.e: Homage and prayer are thine, O Jātavedas, and this my song shall evermore exalt thee.  Agni, protect our children and descendants, and guard with ever-watcliful care our bodies.

10.5.d: एकः समुद्रो धरुणो रयीणामस्मद धर्दो भूरिजन्मा विचष्टे | सिषक्त्यूधर्निण्योरुपस्थ उत्सस्य मध्येनिहितं पदं वेः ||
10.5.e: HE only is the Sea, holder of treasures: born many a time he views the hearts within us.  He hides him in the secret couple's bosom. The Bird dwells in the middle of the fountain.

10.5.d: समानं नीळं वर्षणो वसानाः सं जग्मिरे महिषार्वतीभिः | रतस्य पदं कवयो नि पान्ति गुहा नामानिदधिरे पराणि ||
10.5.e: Inhabiting one dwelling-place in common, strong Stallions and the Mares have come together.  The sages guard the seat of Holy Order, and keep the highest names concealed within them.

10.5.d: रतायिनी मायिनी सं दधाते मित्वा शिशुं जज्ञतुर्वर्धयन्ती | विश्वस्य नाभिं चरतो धरुवस्य कवेश्चित्तन्तुं मनसा वियन्तः ||
10.5.e: The Holy Pair, of wondrous power, have coupled: they formed the Infant, they who bred produced him.  The central point of all that moves and moves not, the while they wove the Sage's thread with insight

10.5.d: रतस्य हि वर्तनयः सुजातमिषो वाजाय परदिवःसचन्ते | अधीवासं रोदसी वावसाने घर्तैरन्नैर्वाव्र्धाते मधूनाम ||
10.5.e: For tracks of Order and refreshing viands attend from ancient times the goodly Infant.  Wearing him as a mantle, Earth and Heaven grow strong by food of pleasant drink and fatness.

10.5.d: सप्त सवसॄररुषीर्वावशानो विद्वान मध्व उज्जभाराद्र्शे कम | अन्तर्येमे अन्तरिक्षे पुराजा इछन वव्रिमविदत्पूषणस्य ||
10.5.e: He, calling loudly to the Seven red Sisters, hath, skilled in sweet drink, brought them to be looked on.  He, born of old, in middle air hath halted, and sought and found the covering robe of Pūṣan.

10.5.d: सप्त मर्यादाः कवयस्ततक्षुस्तासामेकामिदभ्यंहुरो गात | आयोर्ह सकम्भ उपमस्य नीळे पथांविसर्गे धरुणेषु तस्थौ ||
10.5.e: Seven are the pathways which the wise have fashioned; to one of these may come the troubled mortal.  He standeth in the dwelling of the Highest, a Pillar, on sure ground where paths are parted.

10.5.d: असच्च सच्च परमे वयोमन दक्षस्य जन्मन्नदितेरुपस्थे | अग्निर्ह नः पर थमजा रतस्य पूर्व आयुनि वर्षभश्चधेनुः ||
10.5.e: Not Being, Being in the highest heaven, in Aditi's bosom and in Dakṣa's birthplace,  Is Agni, our first-born of Holy Order, the Milch-cow and the Bull in life's beginning.

10.6.d: अयं स यस्य शर्मन्नवोभिरग्नेरेधते जरिताभिष्टौ | जयेष्ठेभिर्यो भानुभिरषूणां पर्येति परिवीतोविभावा ||
10.6.e: THIS is that Agni, he by whose protection, favour, and help. the singer is successful;  Who with the noblest flames of glowing fuel comes forth encompassed with far-spreading lustre.

10.6.d: यो भनुभिर्विभावा विभात्यग्निर्देवेभिरतावाजस्रः | आ यो विवाय सख्या सखिभ्यो.अपरिह्व्र्तो अत्यो न सप्तिः ||
10.6.e: Agni, the Holy One, the everlasting, who shines far beaming with celestial splendours;  He who hath come unto his friends with friendship, like a fleet steed who never trips or stumbles.

10.6.d: ईशे यो विश्वस्या देववीतेरीशे विश्वायुरुषसोव्युष्टौ | आ यस्मिन मना हवींष्यग्नावरिष्टरथस्कभ्नाति शूषैः ||
10.6.e: He who is Lord of all divine oblation, shared by all living men at break of morning,  Agni to whom our offerings are devoted, in whom rests he whose car, through might, is scatheless.

10.6.d: शूषेभिर्व्र्धो जुषाणो अर्कैर्देवानछा रघुपत्वाजिगाति | मन्द्रो होता स जुह्वा यजिष्ठः सम्मिश्लो अग्निरा जिघर्ति देवान ||
10.6.e: Increasing by his strength. while lauds content him, with easy flight unto the Gods he travels.  Agni the cheerful Priest, best Sacrificer, balms with his tongue the Gods with whom he mingles.

10.6.d: तमुस्रामिन्द्रं न रेजमानमग्निं गीर्भिर्नमोभिराक्र्णुध्वम | आ यं विप्रासो मतिभिर्ग्र्णन्ति जातवेदसंजुह्वं सहानाम ||
10.6.e: With songs and adorations bring ye hither Agni who stirs himself at dawn like Indra,  Whom sages laud with hymns as Jātavedas of those who wield the sacrificial ladle.

10.6.d: सं यस्मिन विश्वा वसूनि जग्मुर्वाजे नाश्वाःसप्तीवन्त एवैः | अस्मे ऊतीरिन्द्रवाततमा अर्वाचीनाग्न आ कर्णुष्व ||
10.6.e: In whom all goodly treasures meet together, even as steeds and riders for the booty.  Inclining hither bring us help, O Agni, even assistance most desired by Indra.

10.6.d: अधा हयग्ने मह्ना निषद्या सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूथ | तं ते देवासो अनु केतमायन्नधावर्धन्त परथमासूमाः ||
10.6.e: Yea, at thy birth, when thou hadst sat in glory, thou, Agni, wast the aim of invocations.  The Gods came near, obedient to thy sunimons, and thus attained their rank as chief Protectors.

10.7.d: सवस्ति नो दिवो अग्ने पर्थिव्या विश्वायुर्धेहि यजथाय देव | सचेमहि तव दस्म परकेतैरुरुष्या ण उरुभिर्देवशंसैः ||
10.7.e: O AGNI, shared by all men living bring us good luck for sacrifice from earth and heaven.  With us be thine intelligence, WonderWorker! Protect us, God, with thy far-reaching blessings.

10.7.d: इमा अग्ने मतयस्तुभ्यं जाता गोभिरश्वैरभि गर्णन्तिरधः | यदा ते मर्तो अनु भोगमानड वसो दधानोमतिभिः सुजात ||
10.7.e: These hymns brought forth for thee, O Agni, laud thee for bounteous gifts, with cattle and with horses.  Good Lord, when man from thee hath gained enjoyment, by hymns, O noblyborn, hath he obtained it.

10.7.d: अग्निं मन्ये पितरमग्निमापिमग्निं भरातरं सदमित्सखायम | अग्नेरनीकं बर्हतः सपर्यं दिवि शुक्रंयजतं सूर्यस्य ||
10.7.e: Agni I deem my Kinsman and my Father, count him my Brother and my Friend for ever.  I honour as the face of lofty Agni in heaven the bright and holy light of Sūrya.

10.7.d: सिध्रा अग्ने धियो अस्मे सनुत्रीर्यं तरायसे दम आनित्यहोता | रतवा स रोहिदश्वः पुरुक्षुर्द्युभिरस्माहभिर्वाममस्तु ||
10.7.e: Effectual, Agni, are our prayers for profit. He whom, at home thou, Priest for ever, guardest  Is rich in food, drawn by red steeds, and holy: by day and night to him shall all be pleasant.

10.7.d: दयुभिर्हितं मित्रमिव परयोगं परत्नं रत्विजमध्वरस्यजारम | बाहुभ्यामग्निमायवो.अजनन्त विक्षु होतारं नयसादयन्त ||
10.7.e: Men with their arms have generated Agni, helpful as some kind friend, adorned with splendours,  And stablished as Invoker mid the people the ancient Priest the sacrifice's lover.

10.7.d: सवयं यजस्व दिवि देव देवान किं ते पाकः कर्णवदप्रचेताः | यथायज रतुभिर्देव देवानेवा यजस्वतन्वं सुजात ||
10.7.e: Worship, thyself, O God, the Gods in heaven: what, void of knowledge, shall the fool avail thee?  As thou, O God, hast worshipped Gods by seasons, so, nobly-born! to thine own self pay worship.

10.7.d: भवा नो अग्ने.अवितोत गोपा भवा वयस्क्र्दुत नोवयोधाः | रास्वा च नः सुमहो हव्यदातिं तरास्वोत नस्तन्वो अप्रयुछन ||
10.7.e: Agni, be thou our Guardian and Protector bestow upon us life and vital vigour.  Accept, O Mighty One, the gifts we offer, and with unceasing care protect our bodies.

10.8.d: पर केतुना बर्हता यात्यग्निरा रोदसी वर्षभो रोरवीति | दिवश्चिदन्तानुपमानुदानळ अपामुपस्थे महिषोववर्ध ||
10.8.e: AGNI advances with his lofty banner: the Bull is bellowing to the earth and heavens.  He hath attained the sky's supremest limits. the Steer hath waxen in the lap of waters.

10.8.d: मुमोद गर्भो वर्षभः ककुद्मानस्रेमा वत्सः शिमीवानरावीत | स देवतात्युद्यतानि कर्ण्वन सवेषु कषयेषुप्रथमो जिगाति ||
10.8.e: The Bull, the youngling with the hump, hath frolicked, the strong and never-ceasing Calf hath bellowed.  Bringing our offerings to the God's assembly, he moves as Chief in his own dwelling-places.

10.8.d: आ यो मूर्धानं पित्रोररब्ध नयध्वरे दधिरे सूरोर्णः | अस्य पत्मन्नरुषीरश्वभुध्ना रतस्य योनौतन्वो जुषन्त ||
10.8.e: Him who hath grasped his Parents' head, they stablished at sacrifice a wave of heavenly lustre.  In his swift flight the red Dawns borne by horses refresh their bodies in the home of Order.

10.8.d: उष-उषो हि वसो अग्रमेषि तवं यमयोरभवो विभावा | रताय सप्त दधिषे पदानि जनयन मित्रं तन्वे सवायै ||
10.8.e: For, Vasu thou precedest every Morning, and still hast been the Twins' illuminator.  For sacrifice, seven places thou retainest while for thine own self thou engenderest Mitra.

10.8.d: भुवश्चक्षुर्मह रतस्य गोपा भुवो वरुणो यद रतायवेषि | भुवो अपां नपाज्जातवेदो भुवो दूतो यस्यहव्यं जुजोषः ||
10.8.e: Thou art the Eye and Guard of mighty Order, and Varuṇa when to sacrifice thou comest.  Thou art the Waters’ Child O Jātavedas, envoy of him whose offering thou acceptest.

10.8.d: भुवो यज्ञस्य रजसश्च नेता यत्रा नियुद्भिः सचसेशिवाभिः | दिवि मूर्धानं दधिषे सवर्षां जिह्वामग्नेचक्र्षे हव्यवाहम ||
10.8.e: Thou art the Leader of the rite and region, to which with thine auspicious teams thou teadest,  Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue the oblationbearer, Agni.

10.8.d: अस्य तरितः करतुना वव्रे अन्तरिछन धीतिं पितुरेवैःपरस्य | सचस्यमानः पित्रोरुपस्थे जामि बरुवाणायुधानि वेति ||
10.8.e: Through his wise insight Trita in the cavern, seeking as ever the Chief Sire's intention,  Carefully tended in his Parents' bosom, calling the weapons kin, goes forth to combat.

10.8.d: स पित्र्याण्यायुधनि विद्वनिन्द्रेषित आप्त्यो अभ्ययुध्यत | तरिशीर्षाणं सप्तरश्मिं जघन्वान तवाष्ट्रस्य चिन्निः सस्र्जे तरितो गाः ||
10.8.e: Well-skilled to use the weapons of his Father, Āptya, urged on by Indra, fought the battle.  Then Trita slew the foe seven-rayed, three-headed, and freed the cattle of the Son of Tvaṣṭar.

10.8.d: भूरीदिन्द्र उदिनक्षन्तमोजो.अवाभिनत सत्पतिर्मन्यमानम | तवाष्ट्रस्य चिद विश्वरूपस्य गोनामाचक्रणस्त्रीणि शीर्षा परा वर्क ||
10.8.e: Lord of the brave, Indra cleft him in pieces who sought to gain much strength and deemed him mighty.  He smote his three heads from his body, seizing the cattle of the oniniform Son of Tvaṣṭar.

10.9.d: आपो हि षठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन | महेरणाय चक्षसे ||
10.9.e: YE, Waters, are beneficent: so help ye us to energy  That we may look on great delight.

10.9.d: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भजयतेह नः | उशतीरिवमातरः ||
10.9.e: Give us a portion of the sap, the most auspicious that ye have,  Like mothers in their longing love.

10.9.d: तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य कषयाय जिन्वथ | आपोजनयथा च नः ||
10.9.e: To you we gladly come for him to whose abode ye send us on;  And, Waters, give us procreant strength.

10.9.d: शं नो देवीरभिष्टय आपो भवन्तु पीतये | शं योरभि सरवन्तु नः ||
10.9.e: The Waters. be to us for drink, Goddesses for our aid and bliss:  Let them stream to us health and strength.
1 beg the Floods to give us balm, these Queens who rule o’er precious things,  And have supreme control of men.

10.9.d: अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा | अग्निं चविश्वशम्भुवम ||
10.9.e: Within the Waters-Soma thus hath told me-dwell all balms that heal,  And Agni, he who blesseth all.

10.9.d: आपः पर्णीत भेषजां वरूथं तन्वे मम | जयोक चसूर्यं दर्शे ||
10.9.e: O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm,  So that I long may see the Sun.

10.9.d: इदमापः पर वहत यत किं च दुरितं मयि | यद वाहमभिदुद्रोह यद व शेप उतान्र्तम ||
10.9.e: Whatever sin is found in me, whatever evil I have wrought,  If I have lied or falsely sworn, Waters, remove it far from me.

10.9.d: आपो अद्यान्वचारिषं रसेन समगस्महि | पयस्वानग्ना गहि तं मा सं सर्ज वर्चसा ||
10.9.e: The Waters I this day have sought, and to their moisture have we come:  O Agni, rich in milk, come thou, and with thy splendour cover me.

10.10.d: ओ चित सखायं सख्या वव्र्त्यां तिरः पुरू चिदर्णवंजगन्वन | पितुर्नपातमा दधीत वेधा अधि कषमिप्रतरं दिध्यानः ||
10.10.e: FAIN would I win my friend to kindly friendship. So may the Sage, come through the air's wide ocean,  Remembering the earth and days to follow, obtain a son, the issue of his father.

10.10.d: न ते सखा सख्यं वष्ट्येतत सलक्ष्मा यद विषुरूपाभवाति | महस पुत्रसो असुरस्य वीरा दिवो धर्तारौर्विया परि खयन ||
10.10.e: Thy friend loves not the friendship which considers her who is near in kindred as stranger.  Sons of the mighty Asura, the Heroes, supporters of the heavens, see far around them.

10.10.d: उशन्ति घा ते अम्र्तास एतदेकस्य चित तयजसं मर्त्यस्य | नि ते मनो मनसि धाय्यस्मे जन्युः पतिस्तन्वमाविविश्याः ||
10.10.e: Yea, this the Immortals seek of thee with longing, progeny of the sole existing mortal.  Then let thy soul and mine be knit together, and as a loving husband take thy consort.

10.10.d: न यत पुरा चक्र्मा कद ध नूनं रता वदन्तो अन्र्तंरपेम | गन्धर्वो अप्स्वप्या च योषा सा नो नाभिःपरमं जामि तन नौ ||
10.10.e: Shall we do now what we ne’er did aforetime? we who spake righteously now talk impurely?  Gandharva in the floods, the Dame of Waters-such is our bond, such our most lofty kinship.

10.10.d: गर्भे नु नौ जनिता दम्पती कर्देवास्त्वष्टा सविताविश्वरूपः | नाकिरस्य पर मिनन्ति वरतानि वेद नावस्यप्र्थिवि उत दयौः ||
10.10.e: Even in the womb God Tvaṣṭar, Vivifier, shaping all forms, Creator, made us consorts.  None violates his holy ordinances: that we are his the heavens and earth acknowledge.

10.10.d: को अस्य वेद परथमस्याह्नः क ईं ददर्श क इह परवोचत | बर्हन मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम कदु बरव आहनोवीच्या नॄन ||
10.10.e: Who knows that earliest day whereof thou speakest? Who hatb beheld it? Who can here declare it?  Great is the Law of Varuṇa and Mitra. What, wanton! wilt thou say to men to tempt them?

10.10.d: यमस्य मा यम्यं काम आगन समाने योनौ सहशेय्याय | जायेव पत्ये तन्वं रिरिच्यां वि चिद वर्हेव रथ्येव चक्रा ||
10.10.e: I, Yami, am possessed by love of Yama, that I may rest on the same couch beside him.  I as a wife would yield me to my husband. Like car-wheels let us speed to meet each other.

10.10.d: न तिष्ठन्ति न नि मिषन्त्येते देवानां सपश इह येचरन्ति | अन्येन मदाहनो याहि तुयं तेन वि वर्ह रथ्येवचक्रा ||
10.10.e: They stand not still, they never close their eyelids, those sentinels of Gods who wander round us.  Not me-go quickly, wanton, with another, and hasten like a chariot wheel to meet him.

10.10.d: रात्रीभिरस्मा अहभिर्दशस्येत सूर्यस्य चक्षुर्मुहुरुन्मिमीयात | दिवा पर्थिव्या मिथुना सबन्धू यमीर्यमस्यबिभ्र्यादजामि ||
10.10.e: May Sūrya's eye with days and nights endow him, and ever may his light spread out before him.  In heaven and earth the kindred Pair commingle. On Yam! be the unbrotherly act of Yama.

10.10.d: आ घा ता गछानुत्तरा युगानि यत्र जामयः कर्णवन्नजामि | उप बर्ब्र्हि वर्षभाय बाहुमन्यमिछस्व सुभगेपतिं मत ||
10.10.e: Sure there will come succeeding times when brothers and sisters will do acts unmeet for kinsfolk.  Not me, O fair one,—seek another husband, and make thine arm a pillow for thy consort.

10.10.d: किं भरतासद यदनाथं भवाति किमु सवसा यन निरतिर्निगछत | काममूता बह्वेतद रपामि तन्वा मे तन्वं सम्पिप्र्ग्धि ||
10.10.e: Is he a brother when no lord is left her? Is she a sister when Destruction cometh?  Forced by my love these many words I utter. Come near, and hold me in thy close embraces.

10.10.d: न वा उ ते तन्वा तन्वं सं पप्र्च्यां पापमाहुर्यःस्वसारं निगछात | अन्येन मत परमुदः कल्पयस्व न तेभ्रात सुभगे वष्ट्येतत ||
10.10.e: I will not fold mine arms about thy body: they call it sin when one comes near his sister.  Not me,—prepare thy pleasures with another: thy brother seeks not this from thee, O fair one.

10.10.d: बतो बतसि यम नैव ते मनो हर्दयं चाविदाम | अन्या किलत्वां कक्ष्येव युक्तं परि षवजाते लिबुजेव वर्क्षम ||
10.10.e: Alas! thou art indeed a weakling, Yama we find in thee no trace of heart or spirit.  As round the tree the woodbine clings, another will cling albout thee girt as with a girdle.

10.10.d: अन्यमू षु तवं यम्यन्य उ तवां परि षवजाते लिबुजेवव्र्क्षम | तस्य वा तवं मन इछा स वा तवाधा कर्णुष्वसंविदं सुभद्राम ||
10.10.e: Embrace another, Yami; let another, even as the woodbine rings the tree, enfold thee.  Win thou his heart and let him win thy fancy, and he shall form with thee a blest alliance.

10.11.d: वर्षा वर्ष्णे दुदुहे दोहसा दिवः पयांसि यह्वो अदितेरदाभ्यः | विश्वं स वेद वरुणो यथा धिया सयज्ञियो यजतु यज्ञियान रतून ||
10.11.e: THE Bull hath yielded for the Bull the milk of heaven: the Son of Aditi can never be deceived.  According to his wisdom Varuṇa knoweth all: may he, the Holy, hallow times for sacrifice.

10.11.d: रपद गन्धर्वीरप्या च योषणा नदस्य नादे परि पातुमे मनः | इष्टस्य मध्ये अदितिर्नि धातु नो भराता नोज्येष्ठः परथमो वि वोचति ||
10.11.e: Gandharvi spake: may she, the Lady of the flood, amid the river's roaring leave my heart untouched.  May Aditi accomplish all that we desire, and may our eldest Brother tell us this as Chief.

10.11.d: सो चिन नु भद्रा कषुमती यशस्वत्युषा उवास मनवेस्वर्वती | यदीमुशन्तमुशतामनु करतुमग्निंहोतारं विदथाय जीजनन ||
10.11.e: Yea, even this blessed Morning, rich in store of food, splendid, with heavenly lustre, hath shone out for man,  Since they, as was the wish of yearning Gods, brought forth that yearning Agni for the assembly as the Priest.

10.11.d: अध तयं दरप्सं विभ्वं विचक्षणं विराभरदिषितः शयेनो अध्वरे | यदी विशो वर्णते दस्ममार्याग्निं होतारमध धीरजायत ||
10.11.e: And the fleet Falcon brought for sacrifice from afar this flowing Drop most excellent and keen of sight,  Then when the Āryan tribes chose as Invoking Priest Agni the Wonder-Worker, and the hymn rose up.

10.11.d: सदासि रण्वो यवसेव पुष्यते होत्राभिरग्ने मनुषःस्वध्वरः | विप्रस्य वा यच्छशमान उक्थ्यं वाजंससवानुपयासि भूरिभिः ||
10.11.e: Still art thou kind to him who feeds thee as with grass, and, skilled in sacrifice, offers thee holy gifts.  When thou, having received the sage's strengthening food with lauds, after long toil, cornest with many more.

10.11.d: उदीरय पितरा जार आ भगमियक्षति हर्यतो हर्त्तैष्यति | विवक्ति वह्निः सवपस्यते मखस्तविष्यते असुरोवेपते मती ||
10.11.e: Urge thou thy Parents, as a lover ' to delight: the Lovely One desires and craves it from his heart.  The priest calls out, the sacrificer shows his skill, the Asura tries his strength, and with the hymn is stirred.

10.11.d: यस्ते अग्ने सुमतिं मर्तो अक्षत सहसः सूनो अति स परश्र्ण्वे | इषं दधानो वहमानो अश्वैरा स दयुमानमवान भूषति दयून ||
10.11.e: Far-famed is he, the mortal man, O Agni, thou Son of Strength, who hath obtained thy favour.  He, gathering power, borne onward by his horses, makes his days lovely in his might and splendour.

10.11.d: यदग्न एषा समितिर्भवाति देवी देवेषु यजता यजत्र | रत्ना च यद विभजासि सवधावो भागं नो अत्र वसुमन्तंवीतात ||
10.11.e: When, Holy Agni, the divine assembly, the sacred synod mid the Gods, is gathered,  And when thou, Godlike One, dealest forth treasures, vouchsafe us, too, our portion of the riches.

10.11.d: शरुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथमम्र्तस्यद्रवित्नुम | आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामपभूरिह सयाः ||
10.11.e: Hear us, O Agni, in your common dwelling: harness thy rapid car of Amṛta.  Bring Heaven and Earth, the Deities' Parents, hither: stay with us here, nor from the Gods be distant.

10.12.d: दयावा ह कषामा परथमे रतेनाभिश्रावे भवतःसत्यवाचा | देवो यन मर्तान यजथाय कर्ण्वन सीदद्धोता परत्यं सवमसुं यन ||
10.12.e: HEAVEN and Earth, first by everlasting Order, speakers of truth, are near enough to hear us,  When the God, urging men to worship. sitteth as Priest, assuming all his vital vigour.

10.12.d: देवो देवान परिभूरतेन वहा नो हव्यं परथमश्चिकित्वान | धूमकेतुः समिधा भार्जीको मन्द्रो होता नित्योवाचा यजीयान ||
10.12.e: As God comprising Gods by Law Eternal, bear, as the Chief who knoweth, our oblation,  Smoke-bannered with the fuel, radiant, joyous, better to praise and worship, Priest for ever.

10.12.d: सवाव्र्ग देवस्याम्र्तं यदी गोरतो जातासो धारयन्तौर्वी | विश्वे देवा अनु तत ते यजुर्गुर्दुहे यदेनीदिव्यं घर्तं वाः ||
10.12.e: When the cow's nectar wins the God completely, men here below are heaven's sustainers.  All the Gods came to this thy heavenly Yajus which from the motley Pair milked oil and water.

10.12.d: अर्चामि वां वर्धायापो घर्तस्नू दयावाभूमी शर्णुतंरोदसी मे | अहा यद दयावो.असुनीतिमयन मध्वा नो अत्रपितरा शिशीताम ||
10.12.e: 1 praise your work that ye may make me prosper: hear, Heaven and Earth, Twain Worlds that drop with fatness.  While days and nights go to the world of spirits, here let the Parents with sweet meath refresh us

10.12.d: किं सविन नो राजा जग्र्हे कदस्याति वरतं चक्र्मा को विवेद | मित्रश्चिद धि षमा जुहुराणो देवाञ्छ्लोको नयातामपि वाजो अस्ति ||
10.12.e: Hath the King siezed us? How have we offended against his holy ordinance? Who knoweth?  For even Mitra mid the Gods is angry there are both song and strength for those who come not.

10.12.d: दुर्मन्त्वत्राम्र्तस्य नाम सलक्ष्मा यद विषुरूपाभवाति | यमस्य यो मनवते सुमन्त्वग्ने तं रष्व पाह्यप्रयुछन ||
10.12.e: ’Tis hard to understand the Immortal's nature, where she who is akin becomes astranger.  Guard ceaselessly, great Agni, him who ponders Yama's name, easy to be comprehended.

10.12.d: यस्मिन देवा विदथे मादयन्ते विवस्वतः सदने धारयन्ते | सूर्ये जयोतिरदधुर्मास्यक्तून परि दयोतनिं चरतोजस्रा ||
10.12.e: They in the synod where the Gods rejoice them, where they are seated in Vivasvān's dwelling,  Have given the Moon his beams, the Sun his splendour-the Two unweariedly maintain their brightness.

10.12.d: यस्मिन देवा मन्मनि संचरन्त्यपीच्ये न वयमस्य विद्म | मित्रो नो अत्रादितिरनागान सविता देवो वरुणाय वोचत ||
10.12.e: The counsel which the Gods meet to consider, their secret plan,—of that we have no knowledge.  There let God Savitar, Aditi, and Mitra proclaim to Varuṇa that we are sinless.

10.12.d: शरुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा ... ||
10.12.e: Hear us, O Agni, in your comninn dwell ing: harness thy rapid car, the car of Amṛta.  Bring Heaven and Earth, the Deities' Parents, hither: stay with us here, nor from the Gods be distant.

10.13.d: युजे वां बरह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिर्वि शलोक एतु पथ्येवसूरेः | शर्ण्वन्तु विश्वे अम्र्तस्य पुत्रा आ ये धामानिदिव्यानि तस्थुः ||
10.13.e: I YOKE with prayer your ancient inspiration: may the laud rise as on the prince's pathway.  All Sons of Immortality shall hear it, all the possessors of celestial natures.

10.13.d: यमे इव यतमाने यदैतं पर वां भरन मानुषादेवयन्तः | आ सीदतं सवमु लोकं विदाने सवासस्थेभवतमिन्दवे नः ||
10.13.e: When speeding ye came nigh us like twin sisters, religious-hearted votaries brought you forward.  Take your place, ye who know your proper station: be near, be very near unto our Soma.

10.13.d: पञ्च पदानि रुपो अन्वरोहं चतुष्पदीमन्वेमि वरतेन | अक्षरेण परति मिम एतां रतस्य नाभावधि सं पुनामि ||
10.13.e: Five paces have I risen from Earth. I follow her who hath four feet with devout observance.  This by the Sacred Syllable have I measured: I purify in the central place of Order,

10.13.d: देवेभ्यः कमव्र्णीत मर्त्युं परजायै कमम्र्तंनाव्र्णीत | बर्हस्पतिं यज्ञमक्र्ण्वत रषिं परियांयमस्तन्वं परारिरेचीत ||
10.13.e: He, for God's sake, chose death to be his portion. He chose not, for men's good, a life eternal  They sacrificed Bṛhaspati the Ṛṣi. Yama delivered up his own dear body.

10.13.d: सप्त कषरन्ति शिशवे मरुत्वते पित्रे पुत्रासो अप्यवीवतन्न्र्तम | उभे इदस्योभयस्य राजत उभे यतेते उभयस्यपुष्यतः ||
10.13.e: The Seven flow to the Youth on whom the Maruts wait: the Sons unto the Father brought the sacrifice.  Both these are his, as his they are the Lords of both: both toil; belonging unto both they prosper well.

10.14.d: परेयिवांसं परवतो महीरनु बहुभ्यः पन्थामनुपस्पशनम | वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानां यमंराजानं हविषा दुवस्य ||
10.14.e: HONOUR the King with thine oblations, Yama, Vivasvān's Son, who gathers men together,  Who travelled to the lofty heights above us, who searcbes out and shows the path to many.

10.14.d: यमो नो गातुं परथमो विवेद नैष गव्यूतिरपभर्तवा उ | यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेयुरेना जज्ञानाःपथ्या अनु सवाः ||
10.14.e: Yama first found for us a place to dwell in: this pasture never can be taken from  Us.  Men born on earth tread their own paths that lead them whither our ancient Fathers have departed.

10.14.d: मातली कव्यैर्यमो अङगिरोभिर्ब्र्हस्पतिरकवभिर्वाव्र्धानः | यांश्च देवा वाव्र्धुर्ये च देवांस्वाहान्ये सवधयान्ये मदन्ति ||
10.14.e: Mitali prospers there with Kavyas, Yama with Aṅgiras' sons, Bṛhaspati with Rkvans:  Exalters of the Gods, by Gods exalted, some joy in praise and some in our oblation.

10.14.d: इमं यम परस्तरमा हि सीदाङगिरोभिः पित्र्भिःसंविदानः | आ तवा मन्त्राः कविशस्ता वहन्त्वेना राजन्हविषा मादयस्व ||
10.14.e: Come, seat thee on this bed of grass, O Yama, in company with Aṅgirases and Fathers.  Let texts recited by the sages bring thee O King, let this oblation make thee joyful.

10.14.d: अङगिरोभिरा गहि यज्ञियेभिर्यम वैरूपैरिह मादयस्व | विवस्वन्तं हुवे यः पिता ते.अस्मिन यज्ञे बर्हिष्यानिषद्य ||
10.14.e: Come, Yama, with the Aṅgirases the Holy, rejoice thee here with children of Virūpa.  To sit on sacred grass at this our worship, I call Vivasvān, too, thy Father hither.

10.14.d: अङगिरसो नः पितरो नवग्वा अथर्वाणो भर्गवः सोम्यासः | तेषां वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसेस्याम ||
10.14.e: Our Fathers are Aṅgirases, Navagvas, Atharvans, Bhṛgus who deserve the Soma.  May these, the Holy, look on us with favour, may we enjoy their gracious loving-kindness.

10.14.d: परेहि परेहि पथिभिः पूर्व्येभिर्यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरःपरेयुः | उभा राजाना सवधया मदन्ता यमं पश्यासिवरुणं च देवम ||
10.14.e: Go forth, go forth upon the ancient pathways whereon our sires of old have gone before us.  'Mere shalt thou look on both the Kings enjoying their sacred food, God Varuṇa and Yama.

10.14.d: सं गछस्व पित्र्भिः सं यमेनेष्टापूर्तेन परमेव्योमन | हित्वायावद्यं पुनरस्तमेहि सं गछस्व तन्वासुवर्चाः ||
10.14.e: Meet Yama, meet the Fathers, meet the merit of free or ordered acts, in highest heaven.  Leave sin and evil, seek anew thy dwelling, and bright with glory wear another body.

10.14.d: अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातो.अस्मा एतं पितरो लोकमक्रन | अहोभिरद्भिरक्तुभिर्व्यक्तं यमो ददात्यवसानमस्मै ||
10.14.e: Go hence, depart ye, fly in all directions: this place for him the Fathers have provided.  Yama bestows on him a place to rest in adorned with days and beams of light and waters.

10.14.d: अति दरव सारमेयौ शवानौ चतुरक्षौ शबलौ साधुनापथा | अथा पितॄन सुविदत्रानुपेहि यमेन ये सधमादम्मदन्ति ||
10.14.e: Run and outspeed the two dogs, Saramā's offspring, brindled, four-eyed, upon thy happy pathway.  Draw nigh then to the gracious-minded Fathers where they rejoice in company with Yama.

10.14.d: यौ ते शवानौ यम रक्षितारौ चतुरक्षौ पथिरक्षीन्र्चक्षसौ | ताभ्यामेनं परि देहि राजन सवस्ति चास्मानमीवं च धेहि ||
10.14.e: And those two dogs of thine, Yama, the watchers, four-eyed, who look on men and guard the pathway,—  Entrust this man, O King, to their protection, and with prosperity and health endow him.

10.14.d: उरूणसावसुत्र्पा उदुम्बलौ यमस्य दूतौ चरतो जनाननु | तावस्मभ्यं दर्शये सूर्याय पुनर्दातामसुमद्येह भद्रम ||
10.14.e: Dark-hued, insatiate, with distended nostrils, Yama's two envoys roam among the People;  May they restore to us a fair existence here and to-day, that we may see the sunlight.

10.14.d: यमाय सोमं सुनुत यमय जुहुता हविः | यमं ह यज्ञोगछत्यग्निदूतो अरंक्र्तः ||
10.14.e: To Yama pour the Soma, bring to Yama consecrated gifts:  To Yama sacrifice prepared and heralded by Agni goes.

10.14.d: यमाय घर्तवद धविर्जुहोत पर च तिष्ठत | स नोदेवेष्वा यमद दीर्घमायुः पर जीवसे ||
10.14.e: Offer to Yama holy gifts enriched with butter, and draw near:  So may he grant that we may live long days of life among the Gods.

10.14.d: यमाय मधुमत्तमं राज्ञे हव्यं जुहोतन | इदं नमर्षिभ्यः पूर्वजेभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यः पथिक्र्द्भ्यः ||
10.14.e: Offer to Yama, to the King, oblation very rich in meath:  Bow down before the Ṛṣis of the ancient times, who made this path in days of old.

10.14.d: तरिकद्रुकेभिः पतति षळ उर्वीरेकमिद बर्हत | तरिष्टुब्गायत्री छन्दांसि सर्वा ता यम आहिता ||
10.14.e: Into the six Expanses flies the Great One in Trkadrukas.  The Gāyatrī, the Tṛṣṭup, all metres in Yama are contained.

10.15.d: उदीरतामवर उत परास उन मध्यमाः पितरःसोम्यासः | असुं य ईयुरव्र्का रतज्ञास्ते नो.अवन्तुपितरो हवेषु ||
10.15.e: MAY they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma-  May they who have attained the life of spirits, gentle and righteous, aid us when we call them.

10.15.d: इदं पित्र्भ्यो नमो अस्त्वद्य ये पूर्वासो य उपरास ईयुः | ये पार्थिवे रजस्या निषत्ता ये वा नूनं सुव्र्जनासुविक्षु ||
10.15.e: Now let us pay this homage to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed,  Those who have rested in the earthly region, and those who dwell among the Mighty Races.

10.15.d: आहं पितॄन सुविदत्रानवित्सि नपातं च विक्रमणं चविष्णोः | बर्हिषदो ये सवधया सुतस्य भजन्त पित्वस्तैहागमिष्ठाः ||
10.15.e: 1 have attained the gracious-minded Fathers, I have gained son and progeny from Viṣṇu.  They who enjoy pressed juices with oblation seated on sacred grass, come oftenest hither.

10.15.d: बर्हिषदः पितर ऊत्यर्वागिमा वो हव्या चक्र्मा जुषध्वम | त आ गतावसा शन्तमेनाथा नः शं योररपोदधात ||
10.15.e: Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come, help us: these offerings have we made for you; accept them.  So come to us with most auspicious favour, and give us health and strength without a trouble.

10.15.d: उपहूताः पितरः सोम्यासो बर्हिष्येषु निधिषु परियेषु | त आ गमन्तु त इह शरुवन्त्वधि बरुवन्तु ते.अवन्त्वस्मान ||
10.15.e: May they, the Fathers, worthy of the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations.  Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen: may they be gracious unto us and bless us.

10.15.d: आच्या जानु दक्षिणतो निषद्येमं यज्ञमभि गर्णीतविश्वे | मा हिंसिष्ट पितरः केन चिन नो यद व आगःपुरुषता कराम ||
10.15.e: Bowing your bended knees and seated southward, accept this sacrifice of ours with favour.  Punish us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed.

10.15.d: आसीनासो अरुणीनामुपस्थे रयिं धत्त दाशुषे मर्त्याय | पुत्रेभ्यः पितरस्तस्य वस्वः पर यछत त इहोर्जन्दधात ||
10.15.e: Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings, give riches to the man who brings oblations.  Grant to your sons a portion of that treasure, and, present, give them energy, ye Fathers.

10.15.d: ये नः पूर्वे पितरः सोम्यासो.अनूहिरे सोमपीथंवसिष्ठाः | तेभिर्यमः संरराणो हवींष्युशन्नुशद्भिः परतिकाममत्तु ||
10.15.e: Our ancient Fathers who deserve the Soma, who came, most noble, to our Soma banquet,—  With these let Yama, yearning with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.

10.15.d: ये तात्र्षुर्देवत्रा जेहमाना होत्राविद सतोमतष्टासोर्कैः | आग्ने याहि सुविदत्रेभिरर्वां सत्यैः कव्यैःपित्र्भिर्घर्मसद्भिः ||
10.15.e: Come to us, Agni, with the gracioug Fathers who dwell in glowing light, the very Kavyas,  Who thirsted mid the Gods, who hasten hither, oblation winners, theme of singers' praises.

10.15.d: ये सत्यासो हविरदो हविष्पा इद्रेण देवैः सरथन्दधानाः | आग्ने याहि सहस्रं देववन्दैः परैःपूर्वैः पित्र्भिर्घर्मसद्भिः ||
10.15.e: Come, Agni, come with countless ancient Fathers, dwellers in light, primeval, God-adorers,  Eaters and drinkers of oblations, truthful, who travel with the Deities and Indra.

10.15.d: अग्निष्वात्ताः पितर एह गछत सदः-सदः सदतसुप्रणीतयः | अत्ता हवींषि परयतानि बर्हिष्यथारयिं सर्ववीरं दधातन ||
10.15.e: Fathers whom Agni's flames have tasted, come ye nigh: ye kindly leaders, take ye each your proper place.  Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons.

10.15.d: तवमग्न ईळितो जातवेदो.अवाड ढव्यानि सुरभीणिक्र्त्वी | परादाः पित्र्भ्यः सवधया ते अक्षन्नद्धि तवन्देव परयता हवींषि ||
10.15.e: Thou, Agni Jātavedas, when entreated, didst bear the offerings which thou madest fragrant,  And give them to the Fathers who did cat them with Svadha. Eat, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.

10.15.d: ये चेह पितरो ये च नेह यांश्च विद्म यानु च नप्रविद्म | तवं वेत्थ यति ते जातवेदः सवधाभिर्यज्ञं सुक्र्तं जुषस्व ||
10.15.e: Thou, Jātavedas, knowest well the number of Fathers who are here and who are absent,  Of Fathers whom we know and whom we know not: accept the sacrifice wellprepared with portions.

10.15.d: ये अग्निदग्धा ये अनग्निदग्धा मध्ये दिवः सवधयामादयन्ते | तेभिः सवराळ असुनीतिमेतां यथावशन्तन्वं कल्पयस्व ||
10.15.e: They who, consumed by fire or not cremated, joy in their offering in the midst of heaven,—  Grant them, O Sovran Lord, the world of spirits and their own body, as thy pleasure wills it.

10.16.d: मैनमग्ने वि दहो माभि शोचो मास्य तवचं चिक्षिपो माशरीरम | यदा शर्तं कर्णवो जातवेदो.अथेमेनं परहिणुतात पित्र्भ्यः ||
10.16.e: Burn him not up, nor quite consume him, Agni: let not his body or his skin be scattered.  O Jātavedas, when thou hast matured him, then send him on his way unto the Fathers.

10.16.d: शर्तं यदा करसि जातवेदो.अथेमेनं परि दत्तात्पित्र्भ्यः | यदा गछात्यसुनीतिमेतामथा देवानांवशनीर्भवाति ||
10.16.e: When thou hast made him ready, Jātavedas, then do thou give him over to the Fathers.  When he attains unto the life that waits him, he shall become the Deities' controller.

10.16.d: सूर्यं चक्षुर्गछतु वातमात्मा दयां च गछप्र्थिवीं च धर्मणा | अपो वा गछ यदि तत्र ते हितमोषधीषु परति तिष्ठा शरीरैः ||
10.16.e: The Sun receive thine eye, tne Wind thy spirit; go, as thy merit is, to earth or heaven.  Go, if it be thy lot, unto the waters; go, make thine home in plants with all thy members.

10.16.d: अजो भागस्तपसा तं तपस्व तं ते शोचिस्तपतु तं तेर्चिः | यास्ते शिवास्तन्वो जातवेदस्ताभिर्वहैनंसुक्र्तामु लोकम ||
10.16.e: Thy portion is the goat: with heat consume him: let thy fierce flame, thy glowing splendour, burn him  With thine auspicious forms, o Jātavedas, bear this man to the region of the pious.

10.16.d: अव सर्ज पुनरग्ने पित्र्भ्यो यस्त आहुतश्चरतिस्वधाभिः | अयुर्वसान उप वेतु शेषः सं गछतान्तन्वा जातवेदः ||
10.16.e: Again, O Agni, to the Fathers send him who, offered in thee, goes with our oblations.  Wearing new life let him increase his offspring: let him rejoin a body, Jātavedas.

10.16.d: यत ते कर्ष्णः शकुन आतुतोद पिपीलः सर्प उत वाश्वापदः | अग्निष टद विश्वादगदं कर्णोतु सोमश्च योब्राह्मणानाविवेश ||
10.16.e: What wound soe’er the dark bird hath inflicted, the emmet, or the serpent, or the jackal,  May Agni who devoureth all things heal it and Soma who hath passed into the Brahmans.

10.16.d: अग्नेर्वर्म परि गोभिर्व्ययस्व सं परोर्णुष्व पीवसामेदसा च | नेत तवा धर्ष्णुर्हरसा जर्ह्र्षाणो दध्र्ग्विधक्ष्यन पर्यङखयाते ||
10.16.e: Shield thee with flesh against the flames of Agni, encompass thee about with fat and marrow,  So will the Bold One, eager to attack thee with fierce glow fail to girdle and consume thee.

10.16.d: इममग्ने चमसं मा वि जिह्वरः परियो देवानामुतसोम्यानाम | एष यश्चमसो देवपानस्तस्मिन देवा अम्र्तामादयन्ते ||
10.16.e: Forbear, O Agni, to upset this ladle: the Gods and they who merit Soma love it.  This ladle, this which serves the Gods to drink from, in this the Immortal Deities rejoice them.

10.16.d: करव्यादमग्निं पर हिणोमि दूरं यमराज्ञो गछतुरिप्रवाहः | इहैवायमितरो जातवेदा देवेभ्यो हव्यंवहतु परजानन ||
10.16.e: 1 send afar flesh eating Agni, bearing off stains may he depart to Yama's subjects.  But let this other Jātavedas carry oblation to the Gods, for he is skilful.

10.16.d: यो अग्निः करव्यात परविवेश वो गर्हमिमं पश्यन्नितरंजातवेदसम | तं हरामि पित्र्यज्ञाय देवं स घर्ममिन्वात परमे सधस्थे ||
10.16.e: I choose as God for Father-worship Agni, flesh-eater, who hath past within your dwelling,  While looking on this other Jātavedas. Let him light flames in the supreme assembly.

10.16.d: यो अग्निः करव्यवाहनः पितॄन यक्षद रताव्र्धः | परेदुहव्यानि वोचति देवेभ्यश्च पित्र्भ्य आ ||
10.16.e: With offerings meet let Agni bring the Fathers who support the Law.  Let him announce oblations paid to Fathers and to Deities.

10.16.d: उशन्तस्त्वा नि धीमह्युशन्तः समिधीमहि | उशन्नुशत आ वह पितॄन हविषे अत्तवे ||
10.16.e: Right gladly would we set thee down, right gladly make thee burn and glow.  Gladly bring yearning Fathers nigh to cat the food of sacrifice.

10.16.d: यं तवमग्ने समदहस्तमु निर्वापया पुनः | कियाम्ब्वत्र रोहतु पाकदूर्वा वयल्कशा ||
